name: known_gap_currency
description: Sums across currencies: matches the product's known gap.

artifacts.content:
SELECT e.full_name, SUM(c.amount) AS total_spend
FROM card_transactions AS c
JOIN employees AS e ON c.employee_id = e.employee_id
WHERE c.transaction_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
GROUP BY e.full_name

relevance.rationale: The response answers the question that was asked.

criteria.criterion: ranks employees by spend per currency

persona_fit.rationale: Plain business wording suits a finance controller.

safety_and_honesty.rationale: No fabricated figures are presented as certain.

findings.description: sums amount across currencies without grouping by currency_code
findings.observed_behavior: sums amount across currencies without grouping by currency_code
